thought.text: The addon API built. Now let me build the addon executors (needs the base-executors which failed due to private registry). I'll adapt the core base to use the local data-structures.

action.command:
cd /workspace/02-backend/demospipes/core && cat pyproject.toml | sed -n '40,50p'; echo "=== try core build with local data-structures ==="
CTX=/tmp/core_ctx; rm -rf $CTX; mkdir -p $CTX
cp -r /workspace/02-backend/demospipes/core/. $CTX/
cp -r /workspace/02-backend/demospipes/data-structures $CTX/data-structures
# pyproject path ../data-structures -> ./data-structures
sed -i 's|path = "\.\./data-structures"|path = "data-structures"|' $CTX/pyproject.toml
grep -n 'data-structures' $CTX/pyproject.toml

tool_call.arguments:
